oracle: ISA-derived behavioral checks plus upstream reference lineage; never derive expected data solely from candidate RTL.

criteria.acceptance: 0x8330000f reaches legal fence dispatch and retires without mcause=2; compare 0x0330000f and distinguish FENCE.I.
The scoreboard checks required order edges, not cycle count or forced reorder occurrence. Full RW,RW serialization is a permitted stronger implementation.

Exercise independent AXI channel delays, outstanding responses and aligned scalar/vector memory workloads, fence placement and repeated fences. Vector pressure must first pass baseline qualification with legal integer operations, 0<vl<=VLMAX and vstart=0. Zero-element or unrelated defects are separate findings, not extra FENCE repair obligations.
Keep program result, halted/fault status, trap cause/PC/value and cycle deadline separate. Unexpected trap or incomplete execution fails even if the simulator exits zero.
Run the same ELF/test sequence, profile and schedule against the candidate baseline and repaired design; a parser-only or reference-model-only run is not RTL reproduction.

uvm_components: AXI master/slave agents and control agent
